data.cultural_impact: The name Devsuransh is rooted in Hindu tradition and culture. It represents the deep reverence and belief in the divine presence and intervention in human lives. The prefix ‘Dev’ signifies God, indicating the divine origin and blessings. The suffix ‘Suransh’, signifying descent, symbolizes the idea of a deity coming down to earth to guide and protect humanity. This name reflects the integration of devotion, faith, and respect for gods in the Hindu way of life.
data.spiritual_significance: Devsuransh holds deep spiritual significance as it signifies the belief in the divine presence and intervention in human lives. It signifies that every individual carries the divine spark within them and that they are Children of God. This name inspires people to seek inner wisdom and guidance from the higher self, while also acknowledging the presence and protection of the God/s. It reminds us of our sacred connection to the divine as we embark on our journey through life.

historical_references.reference:
The name 'Devsuransh' is derived from 'Deva' meaning god and 'Suransh' meaning invincible. This name was commonly used by the Rajput clans of central India, particularly the Sisodia clan of Mewar.
Time period: 6th to 18th century
Context: Medieval India, Rajputana

Devsuransh was a title given to the rulers of the Maratha Empire during the late 17th and early 18th century. The Maratha Empire was a significant power in Indian history, controlling much of modern Maharashtra and parts of neighboring states.
Time period: Late 17th to early 18th century
Context: Maratha Empire, Indian history
